usage.headings: Cormorant Garamond for all headings. Sizes should scale fluidly up to 88px on desktop (text-5xl to text-[88px]). Use tight tracking (tracking-tight) and tight line height (leading-[0.95]).
usage.body: Inter for body text, typically 16px-18px (text-base md:text-lg) with relaxed line height (leading-relaxed).
usage.eyebrows: Inter, small (text-xs or text-sm), uppercase, wide tracking (tracking-widest).
usage.quotes: Cormorant Garamond, italic, text-2xl to text-4xl.

layouts.spacing_philosophy: Generous whitespace. Use py-24, py-32, or py-48 for section spacing. Never cramp content.
layouts.grid_system: 12-column grid. Prioritize controlled asymmetry over perfectly centered layouts.
layouts.masonry: Use CSS columns (columns-1 md:columns-2 lg:columns-3 gap-4 space-y-4) for the gallery.

motion.hero_reveal: Cinematic kinetic hero with masked line-by-line reveal. Timing: 450-800ms, stagger 100ms. Easing: cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1).
motion.scroll_reveal: Fade up with very subtle parallax on scroll. No bouncing, spinning, or heavy scaling.
motion.marquee: Slow editorial marquee. Timing: very slow, continuous loop.
motion.accessibility: Always respect prefers-reduced-motion for all framer-motion animations.

AgeGate.description: Full screen overlay on load. Solid background (#0B0A09) to hide content until accepted. Buttons for 'Enter' and 'Exit'.

Navigation.description: Sticky transparent->opaque navigation. Starts transparent, transitions to background: #0B0A09 on scroll (no blur, just solid color for luxury feel). Includes language switcher (ES/EN/FR). Do not use a hamburger menu on desktop.

Hero.description: Cinematic kinetic hero. Contains positioning pull-quote and masked line-by-line reveal of the main heading.

ManifestoChapters.description: Numbered 01-04 sections (About, Travel, Philosophy, Ideal Client). Use thin divider lines (#392D28) and large numbers. Layouts should be asymmetrical, weaving text and images.

ImageBreak.description: Large editorial photo break. Full-width or wide-container with slight parallax effect via framer-motion.

Gallery.description: Editorial masonry layout. Clicking an image opens a fullscreen lightbox. Lightbox must have opaque background (#0B0A09), prev/next controls, image counter (e.g., 1/12), and keyboard navigation (Arrows/Escape).

FAQ.description: Accordion style. Thin divider lines (#392D28) separating questions. Clean interactions. Use Radix/Shadcn accordion but styled heavily to match the brand.

Contact.description: Private contact section. Must include exact text: hours 10:00-22:00, España · Disponibilidad internacional.

Footer.description: Premium dark footer. Incorporates the OnlyFans CTA elegantly (discreet, sophisticated). Links for privacy/terms.

visual_enhancers.buttons: Sharp minimal rectangles or pill-shaped. Minimal borders (1px solid #392D28 or #C8AA72). Hover shifts background slightly to #151311.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay on the primary background (#0B0A09) to give it a physical editorial feel.

hero_abstract.description: Elegant abstract black texture for dark hero accents or age gate background.

travel_hotel.description: Elegant corridor of a heritage hotel, representing international travel.

accent_texture.description: Curved black design for breaks and transitions.

instructions_to_main_agent: Create a configuration file (e.g., config.js or content.js) to store all texts in ES, EN, FR. Implement a simple context or state to toggle languages.
Use Framer Motion for scroll animations and the hero masked line-by-line reveal.
Ensure 'data-testid' attributes are added to all interactive elements (buttons, nav links, language toggles, accordions, gallery items).
Avoid standard SaaS look. Strip Shadcn components (if used) of default borders, shadows, and rounded corners to fit the luxury aesthetic.
No explicit content, imagery, or tones. The OnlyFans CTA must be handled as a premium, exclusive members-club link.
Implement the gallery lightbox securely, without a transparent background behind the image to ensure clear visibility.
Set <meta name="robots" content="noindex"> in the document head for privacy-oriented requirement.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text light #F7F3EC meets contrast standards against #0B0A09 and #151311.
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion media query. If reduced motion is requested, disable parallax and scroll reveals.
accessibility.aria: Use aria-expanded for accordions, aria-hidden for decorative lines.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not use generic centered layouts. Create depth with layering. Use generous spacing (p-12, p-24, py-32). Add micro-animations to all interactive elements. Do not use AI emojis. Implement language switching text dynamically. DO NOT use generic Shadcn cards without heavily stripping their default borders/backgrounds to match the luxury aesthetic. Adhere strictly to the color palette.
